build_gtn_package: build the gtn python package with cmake extensions for graph transducer networks
build_cmake_extension: build a CMakeExtension for gtn modules like _graph or _autograd using CMakeBuild
run_cmake_build: run the CMakeBuild command to compile gtn C++ extensions with cmake version 3.5.1 or higher
load_readme_description: load the README.md file content as the long description for the gtn package setup
setup_gtn_ext_modules: setup the gtn package with seven CMake extensions including _graph, _autograd, _utils, _rand, _creations, _functions, and _parallel
